implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered SCEN-REC-120 confirmatory run using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter with a single hosted model (gpt-5-mini). Follow adapter semantics: one shared initial generation per task, guarded condition may invoke at most one repair call; deterministic validators and automated scoring agents supplied by the adapter will perform all checks and scoring. All runs, logs, and deterministic artifacts will be recorded in the execution manifest.
public_resources: public vendor example set and grammar/specs (project repo)
task_manifest_strategy: Use the preregistered 120 confirmatory intent tasks balanced across 3 vendors × 3 topology-classes as specified in the preregistration; task indices enumerated 1..120; discovery/pilot items (30) executed separately and excluded from confirmatory analysis.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply vendor-specific constrained-DSL generation for baseline and agentic generate→validate→repair (bounded to max 1 repair call per task) for guarded; validators and automatic rejection rules per preregistration implemented via adapter-provided deterministic toolchain.
randomisation_plan: Tasks assigned to batches in fixed seeded order; confirmatory pairs are paired within the same task index. No cross-call context is preserved between tasks; explicit context reset per adapter contract.
caching_plan: Cache deterministic validator artifacts and simulator results; do not cache model responses across distinct task invocations (adapter-enforced fresh context).
failure_recovery_plan: Follow preregistered retry/backoff (1s then 3s) for transient API failures; if retries exhaust, log outcome and apply missingness_plan (complete_pair_primary). Automated re-execution allowed only under adapter retry policy.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 v1.0 (binary end-to-end correctness per pipeline per task, paired outcomes, repair-coverage flags, repair-iteration counts, transient-unsafe-proposal flags)
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated_model_calls = 120 tasks × average 1.5 model calls/task (one shared initial generation + 0.5 average repairs) = 180 calls. Maximum_model_calls = task_count × 2 = 240 (one initial + one repair per task). All within adapter and capability manifest limits.
